STORY: From SpaceX going sky high to Victoria's Secret making a comeback...

:: The Week In Numbers

This is The Week in Numbers.

:: $75 billion

$75 billion is how much SpaceX plans to raise in its upcoming share sale.

That was the word from a Reuters source.

They said Elon Musk’s rocket firm will sell almost 556 million shares at $135 apiece.

Reuters had earlier reported the IPO would see SpaceX valued at $1.75 trillion.

:: $965 billion

$965 billion is how much Anthropic's valuation surged to.

It put the AI startup ahead of Sam Altman's rival OpenAI.

Anthropic announced it had raised $65 billion in its latest funding round, which pushed up its value.

It aims to boost computing capacity to meet growing demand for its chatbot Claude and to scale its products

:: 50%

About 50% is how high Victoria's Secret shares soared post-results.

Investors bought in after the lingerie retailer posted blockbuster quarterly earnings and raised its annual forecasts.

Revenue grew by double digits in the quarter.

It follows CEO Hillary Super's efforts to stop years of falling sales by reining in discounting and leaning back into its former "sexy" image.

:: 60

60 is how many economies the Trump administration has proposed placing more duties on imports of.

It cited failures to curb trade in goods made with forced labor, which it called unreasonable and argued it restricted U.S. commerce.

The duties would reach up to 10% or 12.5% and targets major players like the EU, China and neighbours like Mexico and Canada.

It comes as the Trump administration tries to rebuild its emergency tariffs after they were struck down in February by the U.S. Supreme Court.

:: $2 billion

And up to $2 billion is how much Garth Brooks could sell his music catalog for.

That's what the Wall Street Journal reported.

The country music star is known for hits like 'The Dance' and 'Friends in Low Places'.

The Journal said the deal would cover both Brooks' songwriting and recorded music rights.
